52339-ancient-scottish-lake-dwellings-or.title: Remains Of Lake-Dwellings In England
52339-ancient-scottish-lake-dwellings-or.creator: Robert Munro, M.A.
52339-ancient-scottish-lake-dwellings-or.description: A book by Robert Munro, M.A.. Instead of attempting to interpret the references made to Lake-Dwellings by previous writers (many of which, though correct in point of fact, were little understood by the observers), in virtue of the additional knowledge derived from recent explorations, and giving the substance of their observations in my own language, I have thought it preferable to retain the exact words of the original narrators.

arxiv-2106-09310.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by A.C. Umuhire, J. Uwamahoro, K. Sasikumar Raja, A. Kumari, C. Monstein. Solar radio type II bursts serve as early indicators of incoming geo-effective space weather events such as coronal mass ejections (CMEs). In order to investigate the origin of high-frequency type II bursts (HF type II bursts), we have identified 51 of them (among 180 type II bursts from SWPC reports) that are observed by ground-based Compound Astronomical Low-cost Low-frequency Instrument for Spectroscopy and Transportable Observatory (CALLISTO) spectrometers and whose upper-frequency cutoff (of either

arxiv-2106-12291.title: Comment on “Macroscopic surface charges from microscopic simulations” [J. Chem. Phys. 153, 164709 (2020)]
arxiv-2106-12291.creator: Zhonghan Hu
arxiv-2106-12291.description: Abstract Sayer and Cox (hereafter referred as the authors) recently presented a method to simulate a slab of electrolyte confined between walls composed of n+1 layers of charged surfaces, depicted in Fig.1 (b) of ref. Sayer_Cox2020 , under the 3-dimensional periodic boundary condition (PBC).

arxiv-2112-00390.title: SegDiff: Image Segmentation with Diffusion Probabilistic Models
arxiv-2112-00390.creator: Tomer Amit, Tal Shaharbany, Eliya Nachmani, Lior Wolf
arxiv-2112-00390.description: Abstract Diffusion Probabilistic Methods are employed for state-of-the-art image generation. In this work, we present a method for extending such models for performing image segmentation. The method learns end-to-end, without relying on a pre-trained backbone. The information in the input image and in the current estimation of the segmentation map is merged by summing the output of two encoders.

arxiv-2308-00573.title: Regularity for the Timoshenko system with fractional damping
arxiv-2308-00573.creator: Fredy Maglorio Sobrado Suárez
arxiv-2308-00573.description: Abstract We study the Regularity of the Timoshenko system with two fractional dampings ( − Δ ) τ ​ u t (-\Delta)^{\tau}u_{t} and ( − Δ ) σ ​ ψ t (-\Delta)^{\sigma}\psi_{t} ; both of the parameters ( τ , σ ) (\tau,\sigma) vary in the interval [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] .

arxiv-2405-15506.title: Learning to Discretize Denoising Diffusion ODEs
arxiv-2405-15506.creator: Vinh Tong, Trung-Dung Hoang, Anji Liu, Guy Van den Broeck, Mathias Niepert
arxiv-2405-15506.description: Abstract Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DPMs) are generative models showing competitive performance in various domains, including image synthesis and 3D point cloud generation. Sampling from pre-trained DPMs involves multiple neural function evaluations (NFEs) to transform Gaussian noise samples into images, resulting in higher computational costs compared to single-step generative models such as GANs or VAEs.

arxiv-2408-08000.title: MVInpainter: Learning Multi-View Consistent Inpainting to Bridge 2D and 3D Editing
arxiv-2408-08000.creator: Chenjie Cao, Chaohui Yu, Fan Wang, Xiangyang Xue, Yanwei Fu
arxiv-2408-08000.description: Abstract Novel View Synthesis (NVS) and 3D generation have recently achieved prominent improvements. However, these works mainly focus on confined categories or synthetic 3D assets, which are discouraged from generalizing to challenging in-the-wild scenes and fail to be employed with 2D synthesis directly. Moreover, these methods heavily depended on camera poses, limiting their real-world applications.

arxiv-2505-07908.title: A Reproduction Study: The Kernel PCA Interpretation of Self-Attention Fails Under Scrutiny
arxiv-2505-07908.creator: Karahan Sarıtaş, Çağatay Yıldız
arxiv-2505-07908.description: Abstract In this reproduction study, we revisit recent claims that self-attention implements kernel principal component analysis (KPCA) Teo and Nguyen (2024) , positing that (i) value vectors V V capture the eigenvectors of the Gram matrix of the keys, and (ii) that self-attention projects queries onto the principal component axes of the key matrix K K in a feature space.

arxiv-2510-08419.title: Continuous Variable Hamiltonian Learning at Heisenberg Limit via Displacement-Random Unitary Transformation
arxiv-2510-08419.creator: Xi Huang, Lixing Zhang, Di Luo
arxiv-2510-08419.description: Abstract Characterizing the Hamiltonians of continuous-variable (CV) quantum systems is a fundamental challenge laden with difficulties arising from infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces and unbounded operators. Existing protocols for achieving the Heisenberg limit precision are often restricted to specific Hamiltonian structures or demand experimentally challenging resources.

arxiv-2510-12302.title: CoLF Logic Programming as Infinitary Proof Exploration
arxiv-2510-12302.creator: Zhibo Chen, Frank Pfenning
arxiv-2510-12302.description: Abstract Logical Frameworks such as Automath [ 2 ] or LF [ 7 ] were originally conceived as metalanguages for the specification of foundationally uncommitted deductive systems, yielding generic proof checkers. Their high level of abstraction was soon exploited to also express algorithms over deductive systems such as theorem provers, type-checkers, evaluators, compilers, proof transformers, etc.

britannica-1911-macleod-norman.title: Macleod, Norman (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-macleod-norman.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-macleod-norman.description: Article 'Macleod, Norman' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 17), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Norman Macleod, minister of Morven, Argyllshire, was born at Campbeltown on the 3rd of June 1812. In 1827 he became a student at Glasgow University, and in 1831 went to Edinburgh to study divinity under Dr Thomas Chalmers. On the 18th of March 1838 he became parish minister at Loudoun, Ayrshire.

doe-osti-3363881-radio-frequency-field-p.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. europmc-pmc3709294.title: What are the benefits of interacting with nature?
europmc-pmc3709294.creator: Keniger LE, Gaston KJ, Irvine KN, Fuller RA.
europmc-pmc3709294.description: There is mounting empirical evidence that interacting with nature delivers measurable benefits to people. Reviews of this topic have generally focused on a specific type of benefit, been limited to a single discipline, or covered the benefits delivered from a particular type of...

pmc-10572257.title: The Feasibility of Make My Day—A Randomized Controlled Pilot Trial of a Stroke Prevention Program in Primary Healthcare
pmc-10572257.creator: Emelie Mälstam, Eric Asaba, Elisabet Åkesson, Susanne Guidetti, Ann-Helen Patomella, Stefania Paduano, Laura Dallolio
pmc-10572257.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Incorporating and sustaining engaging everyday activities (EEAs) in everyday life holds potential for improving health and wellbeing; thus, there is reason to explore EEAs as a behavioral change technique in stroke prevention. The aim of this study was to evaluate the feasibility of the stroke prevention program Make My Day (MMD) for people with moderate-to-high risk for stroke in a primary healthcare setting, where EEAs are utilized to promote healthy activity patterns.

pmc-11490848.title: A rare case of giant mediastinal tumor originating from lung tissue characterized by high fever and arrhythmia
pmc-11490848.creator: Xiujing Yao, Ruyue Li, Ying Li, Mengru Liu, Yintao Li
pmc-11490848.description: BackgroundArrhythmias in patients with cancer are predominantly attributed to heart disease, anti-tumor drugs, and primary cardiac tumors. Arrhythmias directly induced by noncardiac primary tumors are rare. To date, there have been no reported cases of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia or sinus bradycardia caused by a posterior mediastinal tumor originating from the lung tissue.

pmc-12446295.title: Tackling the long-tailed challenge of greenhouse tomato cultivation cycles recognition: a sub-group guided, multi-expert lightweight framework
pmc-12446295.creator: Ruochen Zhang, Jingxin Yu, Lin Han, Huankang Cui, Lichun Wang, Fan Xu, Xiaoming Wei
pmc-12446295.description: IntroductionGreenhouse tomato cultivation cycles recognition is often impeded by the long-tailed challenge, arising from significant differences in cycle lengths affecting data distribution. This imbalance hinders accurate recognition, particularly for rare stages, limiting intelligent management in precision agriculture.MethodsThis study proposes a lightweight framework integrating a novel multi-expert grouping strategy with knowledge distillation.

pmc-12641054.title: Predictors of Abdominal Pain Duration in Henoch–Schönlein Purpura and Nomogram Model Development: A Retrospective Study of 220 Cases
pmc-12641054.creator: Hong Huang, Xin Chen, Yun Pan, Yichi Zhang, Rentao Yu, Aijun Chen
pmc-12641054.description: ObjectiveOur study aims to identify risk factors that predict an abnormally prolonged duration of abdominal pain relief (DAPR) in patients with abdominal Henoch–Schönlein purpura (A-HSP) and to construct a nomogram for early prediction.MethodsWe reviewed data of all patients (n = 375) with confirmed A-HSP from the Chongqing Medical University platform, from 22 January 2011 to 18 November 2022.

pmc-13067017.title: Conservative Management of Subluxation Injuries in Young Permanent Teeth Using Fiber-Reinforced Composite Splints: Review and Case Reports
pmc-13067017.creator: Mridula Goswami, Vashi Narula, Vishal Vishal
pmc-13067017.description: Subluxation of young permanent teeth poses a significant clinical challenge due to its potential impact on pulp vitality, periodontal healing, and esthetics. Luxation injuries in anterior teeth are more common in children and adolescents, often resulting from sports injuries, falls, or accidents. Management of these injuries requires accurate diagnosis, prompt repositioning, and effective stabilization.

pmc-13253081.title: A multicentre audit of the geometric accuracy and water equivalence of 3D printed thermoplastic objects for use in radiotherapy☆
pmc-13253081.creator: Matthew R. Jones, Peter D. Woolliams, Matthew A. Bolt, Owen McLaughlin, Maria Boutros, Tristan Wright, Rhys Jenkins, Anna Tonino, Fiona Milliken, Neil Bentley, Gordon D. Sands, James C.L. Burnley, Paul J. Doolan, Dualta McQuaid, Geoff J. Budgell, Elizabeth J. Adams, Conor K. McGarry, Catharine H. Cl
pmc-13253081.description: Graphical abstract Introduction Increasing adoption of 3D printing techniques in radiotherapy has seen fabrication of dosimetric and patient-specific phantoms, brachytherapy applicators, bolus structures, patient immobilization and proton beam compensators [1], [2], [3], [4], [5]. Water is the reference material for radiotherapy dosimetry, and plastics are commonly substituted when water use is impractical [6], [7], [8].

pmc-13447828.title: KBDR: document retrieval based on graph matching with knowledge enhancement
pmc-13447828.creator: Jingxuan Liu, Yihan Huang, Jialuoyi Tan, Zhen Hua
pmc-13447828.description: Document retrieval refers to the identification of document contents that are semantically most relevant within a corpus. Existing matching algorithms may not recognize the synonymy of all documents for vocabulary, leading to retrieval inaccuracies. To address this limitation, this paper proposes Knowledge Based Document Retrieval (KBDR) that utilizes graph-based knowledge expansion.

pmc-13462124.title: Fluid-mediated nuclearity control in heterogeneous polyolefin catalysis
pmc-13462124.creator: Zaitian He, Jingyuan Sun, Qingyuan Zheng, Wei Li, Lynn F. Gladden, Jingdai Wang, Yongrong Yang
pmc-13462124.description: The nuclearity of active sites in heterogeneous Ziegler-Natta catalysts fundamentally governs polyolefin microstructure, yet its dynamic regulation during polymerization remains challenging. Here, we report a liquid containing polymerization strategy that directs the formation of dinuclear titanium species through periodic wetting-drying of inert n-hexane on the catalytic particles.

pmc-13516173.title: The Role of Prior-Induced Regularization in Accuracy and Stability of Genomic Prediction Across Unimodal and Multimodal Models
pmc-13516173.creator: Osval A. Montesinos-López, José Elías Peregrina-Chavarría, Abelardo Montesinos-López, José Crossa, Ivana N. Briseño-Rodríguez, Roberto de la Rosa Santa-María, Nereyda C. Pérez-González, Karol D. Johnston-Navarro, Mayte Muñoz-Rosales, Verónica M. Guzmán-Sandoval, Iván Delgado-Enciso, Luis Posadas, Re
pmc-13516173.description: In this study, we assessed the impact of prior-induced regularization using six real datasets from wheat, rice, and potato, spanning 107–758 genotypes, 2–12 environments, 1–18 traits, and 2744–108,024 molecular markers. Two modeling scenarios were evaluated: (i) unimodal genomic prediction based solely on marker information and (ii) multimodal (multi-component) prediction integrating genomic, environmental, and genotype-by-environment (G × E) effects.

pmc-13549146.title: Psychosocial burden and quality of life impairment in adults with vitiligo: a cross-sectional assessment
pmc-13549146.creator: Asma Malawi Alshahrani, Rajalakshimi Vasudevan, Amjad Hmlan, Abdullah Mohammed Asiri, Ahmad Mohammed Assiri, Praveen Devanandan, Geetha Kandasamy, Krishnaraju Venkatesan
pmc-13549146.description: BackgroundVitiligo, a chronic autoimmune depigmenting disorder, substantially affects patients’ psychosocial well-being despite its benign physical course. Limited evidence from Saudi Arabia explores the quality-of-life (QoL) impact of vitiligo and its clinical correlates.ObjectiveTo assess QoL impairment among adults with vitiligo and to determine the relationship between disease characteristics and Dermatology Life Quality Index (DLQI) scores.

pmc-13556115.title: Exploring the experiences, views, and needs of family members of emergency response workers: a systematic review and meta-synthesis
pmc-13556115.creator: Hana Matoshi, Jo Billings, Maya Janse Van Rensburg, Sahra Tekin
pmc-13556115.description: Background: Emergency responders, including firefighters, police officers, and paramedics, face workplace challenges that may harm their well-being. They typically rely on family members for support, which may have damaging effects on the family system. While the experiences of emergency responders are well established, their families’ subsequent struggles are less well explored.

pmc-13611788.title: A G4P[13] Porcine Rotavirus a Strain with Genomic Features Suggestive of Reassortment: Isolation, Genomic Characterization, and Pathogenicity in Piglets
pmc-13611788.creator: Xianyu Zhang, Rui Geng, Shengjin Liu, Liguo Gao, Qunhui Li, Yongchang Cao, Yu Wu, Hanqin Shen
pmc-13611788.description: Simple SummaryDiarrhea in newborn piglets is an important disease that causes economic losses in the swine industry. In this study, we identified and characterized a new rotavirus strain from diarrheic piglets in China. The virus showed unique genetic features compared with previously reported pig rotaviruses and was able to cause diarrhea, intestinal damage, and virus shedding in young pigs.
